description_en: Call the AttachDbfs operation to attach a pay-as-you-go database file system to an ECS instance. The ECS instance and the database file system must be in the same zone
description_zh: 调用AttachDbfs为一台ECS实例挂载一个按量付费的数据库文件系统。ECS实例和数据库文件系统必须在同一个可用区内
kebab_example: aliyun dbfs attach-dbfs --ecs-instance-id i-bp1ecr000000005go2go --server-url dbfs-pkg-cn-hangzhou.oss-cn-hangzhou.aliyuncs.com --fs-id dbfs-v0WvA00000000tVEVcgJLg --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --attach-mode create_new_mount_point --attach-point /mnt/dbfs/dbfs-001 --region cn-hangzhou
name: AttachDbfs

parameters.help_en: The ID of the destination ECS instance
parameters.name: ecs_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The address of the DBFS package. This parameter is deprecated
parameters.help_zh: DBFS软件包地址，已废弃不再使用
parameters.name: server_url

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the database file system to attach.
The database file system (FsId) and the ECS instance (ECSInstanceId) must be in the same zone
parameters.help_zh:
待挂载的数据库文件系统ID。
数据库文件系统（FsId）和ECS实例（ECSInstanceId）必须在同一个可用区内
parameters.name: fs_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the region. You can call the DescribeRegions (https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html) operation to view the latest list of Alibaba Cloud regions
parameters.help_zh: 所属的地域ID。您可以调用DescribeRegions (https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html)查看最新的阿里云地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The attach mode. Valid values:

```
create_new_mount_point - Create a new mount target (default)
use_exist_mount_point - Use an existing mount target
```
parameters.help_zh:
挂载模式。取值范围：
```
create_new_mount_point - 创建新挂载点（默认值）
use_exist_mount_point - 使用已有挂载点
```
parameters.name: attach_mode

parameters.help_en: The path of the mount target. If you do not specify this parameter, a path is randomly generated
parameters.help_zh: 挂载点路径，不填写则随机生成
parameters.name: attach_point
